class.name: IfcFillAreaStyle
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The style for filling visible curve segments, annotation fill areas or surfaces with tiles or hatches. An IfcFillAreaStyle provides the style table for presentation information assigned to annotation fill areas or surfaces for hatching and tiling. members.member: The set of fill area styles to use in presenting visible curve segments, annotation fill areas or surfaces.
